adamsarsplus:abyssal_domination.d: Attacking a living creature inflicts Disruption on it for 5 seconds.

adamsarsplus:earthen_heart.d: Halves maximum mana and grants a Health Boost that grows with max mana (about one level per 48 mana).

adamsarsplus:flame_deity_aura.d: Marks every other creature nearby that is not already marked with Marked for Cremation for 4 seconds.

adamsarsplus:holy_legion.d: Tied to a summoned Terraprisma: the effect is removed from its summoner when the Terraprisma dies.

adamsarsplus:lightning_steps.d: While it lasts, Leap Fatigue is removed.

adamsarsplus:walking_blizzard.d: At level II, the next hit does no damage and makes the creature immune for 2 seconds; the effect then drops to level I for 30 seconds.

brutality:enraged.d: Rage mode: starts when a player's rage meter fills while wearing the Anger Management curio. It raises attack and movement and lowers armor, more at higher levels.

brutality:pulverized.d: Takes damage every tick, and its hit immunity is reset each time so every hit lands.

caster_curios_bonus:arcane_overdrive.d: Spells cost no mana but build up overload; when it fills, the effect ends and the caster is silenced.

cataclysm:abyssal_curse.d: Takes 1 abyssal burn damage every 2.5 seconds at level I, with the gap halving each level.

cofh_core:love.d: Puts an adult animal that is not already in love into breeding mode, with heart particles.

goetydelight:warden.d: Senses nearby vibrations like a Warden; after sensing one, the creature deals extra damage to its source for 5 seconds.

gtbcs_geomancy_plus:seismic_ride_timer.d: Timer for the Seismic Surf spell: applied when it is cast, lasting 11 seconds less than the spell's duration.

irons_spellbooks:burning_dash.d: While dashing, damages creatures it touches with Burning Dash spell damage and ends when the creature hits a wall.

irons_spellbooks:volt_strike.d: While dashing, damages creatures it touches with Volt Strike spell damage.

legendary_monsters:unbreakable.d: A player with it takes no damage from any hit.

oddaccessories:tetanus.d: Cannot be removed or cured by normal means, and cannot be inflicted on a creature that has Sepsis.

peyroscythe:forever_young.d: Turns a mob that can be a baby (animals, zombies, piglins, zoglins) into a baby while it lasts.

peyroscythe:illusion_crazy.d: Makes a mob turn on the nearest creature around it, friend or foe; some creature types are immune.

peyroscythe:illusion_fear.d: Makes a mob run away from whoever cast the spell; some creature types are immune.

refined_mod:hunters_mark_buff.d: Changes the spell damage its holder deals to the creature marked by Hunter's Mark, by an amount set by the effect's level.

simplymore:bleed.d: Loses 1 health every 1.75 seconds at level I, with the gap halving each level, and heals only half as much.

simplymore:blessing.d: Absorbs the next hit: the damage is cancelled, the effect is used up and the creature is healed.

simplymore:bloom.d: Gives short pulses of Speed and Resistance (about 1 second each) while it lasts.

simplymore:chill.d: Gradually builds up freezing on the creature, as powder snow does.

simplymore:curse.d: The next time it takes damage, the curse is used up and it gets Slowness IV and Blindness.

simplymore:hex.d: Keeps getting short bursts of Slowness, Mining Fatigue and Weakness, and the hex grows a level about every 5 seconds.

simplymore:mistified.d: A dash from the Smouldering Ruin: the first creature in its path that is not an ally takes 8 damage and gets Withering Fate for 30 seconds. The dash ends on landing.

simplymore:radiant_mark.d: Marks a creature for the Lustrous Moxie sword, which can later teleport its wielder to the marked target and strike it.

simplymore:ravenous.d: Rushes forward the way it faces, pushed along every other tick.

simplymore:starlight.d: Gets short bursts of Speed, more often at higher levels.

simplymore:tidebreaker_rain.d: Rain falls around it, and every creature within 3 blocks that is not its ally gets Insanity for 8 seconds.

simplymore:venom.d: Takes 2 damage at a time (1 when nearly dead), every 1.25 seconds at level I and faster at higher levels, but never enough to kill.

simplyswords:fatal_flicker.d: Dashes forward the way it is looking, briefly immune to hits and with Resistance IV.

simplyswords:magistorm.d: While a Magiscythe is held, it keeps striking a random target in range, for damage that grows with the weapon.

simplyswords:resilience.d: Negates incoming hits against a player, using up one level of the effect each time.

simplyswords:ward.d: Once a second, a player gets a brief Absorption shield that grows with their current health, about one extra level per 4 health.

soulsweapons:retribution.d: Hits from the Dawnbreaker stack it, each refresh lasting 4 seconds; a creature that dies with it may explode, more likely at higher levels.

summonity:radiated.d: Takes radiation damage over time, every 1.25 seconds, and faster at higher levels.

terramity:ability_cooldown.d: Blocks the item or accessory ability that applied it from being used again while it lasts, and milk cannot cure it.

terramity:amped.d: Hits it lands deal 50% more damage.

terramity:divine_flight.d: Lets it fly. Above height 320 the effect is removed with the message "You cannot fly that high!".

terramity:dizzy.d: Has Nausea for as long as it lasts, and a player's screen wobbles.

terramity:hexed.d: Does nothing while it lasts; when it ends, its health is cut in half unless something protects it.

terramity:immunity.d: Clears harmful effects every tick, among them Weakness, Wither, Poison, Slowness, Blindness, Nyxium Fire and Dizzy.

terramity:mirroring.d: Whenever it hits something, it takes half of that damage itself.

terramity:nyxium_fire.d: Burns for 3 shadowflame damage at a time while it lasts, unless it wears the full Nyxium Knight set.

terramity:universal_transcendence.d: Flies along the way it is looking, one block a tick; a player is in Spectator mode while it lasts and gets Creative or Survival back after.

traveloptics:aerial_collapse_helper.d: Holds it hovering just above the ground, over jet flames; it cannot be removed early.

traveloptics:crimson_descend.d: While gliding it slams the creature downward, and when it touches the ground it releases a shockwave and the effect ends.

weapon:slow.d: Can barely move while on the ground.
